description: MainActivity.java defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, which extends SampleActivityBase. It manages UI components such as a fragment and a log display, handles menu actions to toggle log visibility, and initializes logging chain with custom log handlers.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages UI fragments and logging for the ElevationDrag sample app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the ElevationDragFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling log visibility and setting the menu item title based on mLogShown.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display and updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain with custom log wrappers and filters, and links the log fragment for on-screen display.
